title: Assignment at a literal coordinate
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on distinct coordinates with width at most $w$, and let $B$ be a block code on $w$ positions. At the coordinate of any literal in $T$, the assignment constructed from $B$ equals the bit of $B$ at that literal's embedded position, added in $\mathbb{F}_2$ to the inverse sign encoding of the literal's required sign.
hypotheses_covered: A term T on n coordinates
The width of T is at most w
A block code B on w positions
A literal position j in T
